content.short: Xion Global is a multi-chain crypto payment gateway.
content.description: Managing crypto payments is challenging due to the risk of lost funds from sending to the wrong addresses, time-consuming manual accounting with block explorers, and high churn from manual subscription collections. Xion Global's Xion Web3 Checkout addresses these problems and simplifies the crypto payment process with a secure checkout, automated transaction reporting and reconciliation, and subscription management tools that boost revenue and customer retention. It supports multiple chains, including Polygon, Bitcoin, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet and Avalanche.
